claims.evidence: The report identifies a bicycle but does not show it is a kids model or comment on strength or condition.
Age or year of manufacture is not shown and cannot be proven from photos alone.
Brake levers are visible but brake performance and gear function are not shown; still photos cannot demonstrate operation.
The report does not mention rust; close-up photos of the frame, rack, and drivetrain would settle it.
Brand and model are not readable, so originality cannot be confirmed from the photos.

risks.risk: The bicycle may not be in working order.
risks.proof: A video clip of the bicycle being ridden or at least the wheels spun and brakes applied.

risks.risk: Tire tread and tube condition are unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tire tread and sidewalls, or a clip showing the tires holding air.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing new tires or tubes.

risks.risk: Brake performance and cable condition are unknown.
risks.proof: A video clip of the brake levers being squeezed and the wheels stopping.

risks.risk: Age or year of manufacture is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the frame serial number or a purchase receipt.

risks.risk: Service history or recent repairs are unknown.
risks.proof: Photos of service receipts or repair records.

risks.risk: A lock or keys may not be included.
risks.proof: A photo showing any lock and keys with the bicycle.

risks.risk: Brand and model are unknown, which affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the frame branding or head tube logo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unbranded or unknown make.

proof_requests: Video of the bicycle being ridden or operated
Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls
Video of brake levers being applied
Photo of frame serial number or purchase receipt
Photo of any lock and keys
Clear photo of frame branding or logo
response.reason: The witness identifies a bicycle, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's claims about age, function, rust, and originality are unproven and do not prevent a worst-case price.
